capabilities.name: selected_index
capabilities.note: R4 closes list selected_index on a backend-truth-first contract, including the unselected -1 state. Native CLICKED_ITEM first synchronizes backend selection, then public/internal/cache state converge to the same index. Hidden or disabled lists release focus and rejected queued/native selection is rolled back to the current backend truth instead of leaving split-brain state. Repeated CLICKED_ITEM on the same index is a no-op and does not define a stronger confirm API.

capabilities.note: callback cookie is intentionally separate from widget-level user_data

capabilities.name: style_class
capabilities.note: List style_class is a stable widget-level metadata contract. It is intentionally separate from any stronger item-level renderer identity.

capabilities.name: widget_level_user_data
capabilities.note: Widget-level user_data is stably stored on widget/backend metadata and remains distinct from on_selected callback cookies.
